choice: The helper runs /usr/bin/open by absolute path, and the page posts links to /api/open instead of navigating.
context: Clicking an issue first opened Linear in a cmux browser split inside the Dock, next to the panel.
rejected: Plain `open` from PATH: cmux terminals put Contents/Resources/bin/open first in PATH, a wrapper that sends http(s) URLs to cmux's in-app browser.
title: Inside cmux terminals `open URL` opens cmux's own browser, not the system one
